stories.title: Paper Mario depth from flat PNGs and Unity scene settings
stories.blurb: Ogre Pixel builds Castlebound entirely from flat sprites exported as PNGs; the 3D look comes from Unity scene configuration, and lighting settings alone shift levels between day, noon and night. A useful pattern for teams who want depth without a 3D asset pipeline.

sources.name: Creative Bloq
sources.headline: Castlebound devs explain a unique Unity technique behind its Paper Mario-like visuals

stories.title: The Balbusso Twins use a reduced palette as narrative device
stories.blurb: For the Folio Society Handmaid's Tale the twins limited colour to white, black, grey and red to mirror the regime's reduction of thought, then extended it with Gilead's own colour codes for The Testaments. Hand-made textures are scanned and layered in Photoshop, and a new plate was added to echo the sequel's final image.

sources.name: Creative Boom
sources.headline: The Balbusso Twins on revisiting The Handmaid s Tale, and why book illustration is like making a movie

stories.title: From typesetter to desktop publisher, a template for AI-era roles
stories.blurb: Christian Crumlish recalls how PCs folded the work of word processor, typesetter and layout artist into one desktop-publishing job at Sybex. Typesetters who refused retraining lost their careers, those who took it became desktop publishers. He expects teams to shrink the same way now and calls the current stretch an in-between phase before new titles settle.

sources.name: UX Collective
sources.headline: Five pairs of hands: what the typesetters can teach designers about AI
sources.author: Vlad Derdeicea

stories.title: Matalan borrows luxury fashion film grammar, then pulls back
stories.blurb: Ozo's Be the Occasion opens with the moody close-ups of high-end fashion advertising and then reveals an ordinary woman getting ready for Christmas at home. Creative Boom's point: the joke lands on the genre's conventions, not on the audience, and needs no words.

sources.name: Creative Boom
sources.headline: Ozo s campaign for Matalan pulls off a clever catwalk switcheroo

stories.title: Sapjack builds a brand world to sell a whole category
stories.blurb: The brand is number one in organic pure maple syrup, but household penetration of real maple is low. Heart Soul Marketing chose an animated forest world built around its steamcrafting process instead of telling buyers they had chosen the wrong syrup.

sources.name: Roastbrief
sources.headline: Sapjack Is Creating a Brand World for Maple Syrup

stories.title: Disney pays Adobe for private models trained on its characters
stories.blurb: After its OpenAI deal fell apart, Disney is using Firefly Foundry to build models on its characters, environments and styles that stay in-house, from Imagineering to ESPN. State of Brand reads it as a warning to agencies: a software vendor now does work that used to sit with them, and brand archives become training data.

sources.name: State of Brand
sources.headline: Disney Walked Away From OpenAI. Today It Signed With Adobe to Train AI on Its Own Characters. | State of Brand

sources.name: The Verge
sources.headline: Disney and Adobe are building generative AI tools together

sources.name: Creative Bloq
sources.headline: Disney's AI deal with Adobe is raising eyebrows

stories.title: Ogilvy and CAA turn one celebrity shoot into licensed AI variants
stories.blurb: ECHO generates localised extension assets from a single hero shoot, using talent scans stored in the CAA Vault, with contract rules enforced by the system and talent sign-off required on every asset. It is a press release, but it shows how agencies plan to package likeness rights.

sources.name: Roastbrief
sources.headline: Ogilvy Launches ECHO, the Industry s First Talent Consent-Based Creative AI Platform

stories.title: US art school costs $77,700 a year while schools close
stories.blurb: Elizabeth Goodspeed puts the average cost of a private US art school at about $370 per enrolled day and lists closures since 2022, including the San Francisco Art Institute. Her question is why the field accepts that only those who can pay get an art education.

sources.name: It's Nice That
sources.headline: Elizabeth Goodspeed on the impossible economics of art education in the US

stories.title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and a gated Mythos 5.2
stories.blurb: Anthropic claims gains in coding, reasoning and vision plus faster output than 5.1; Fable is available today, Mythos only to vetted organisations. Ethan Mollick, who tested it before launch, calls the state "Jagged AGI": expert-level on many computer tasks, still uneven in ways that are harder to describe than plain errors.

sources.name: The Verge
sources.headline: Anthropic launches new Claude Fable and Mythos 5.2 models

sources.name: TechCrunch
sources.headline: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns

stories.title: Claude Code's "don't ask again" writes secrets into repos
stories.blurb: Apiiro found thousands of passwords, API tokens and root logins in .claude/settings.local.json files on public GitHub. Approving a shell command permanently stores the command as written, credentials included. Anyone prototyping with Claude Code should check that file is gitignored.

sources.name: Ars Technica
sources.headline: Claude Code is accidentally exposing secrets all over GitHub

stories.title: Instagram lets anyone prompt their own Stories filters
stories.blurb: Effect Builder takes a text prompt plus optional style reference images, previews the result on your photos and submits it for a safety review before others can use it. In The Verge's test, the AI-rewritten long prompt produced almost the same filter as the one-liner.

sources.name: The Verge
sources.headline: Instagram’s Effect Builder makes new filters from AI prompts
